verbatim: 5. **Offline ORB-SLAM3 smoke test crashed (SIGSEGV)** on the first frame (MEASURED, gdb): `main → System::GetTimeFromIMUInit → LocalMapping::GetCurrKFTime`. Cause: upstream ORB-SLAM3 never initializes `LocalMapping::mpCurrentKeyFrame`, so the null check reads garbage before the first keyframe (the EuRoC example never calls this function, so N4A was unaffected). Patch 4: `KeyFrame* mpCurrentKeyFrame = nullptr;` in `include/LocalMapping.h` (committed in the Pi build copy). **The rebuild was interrupted by a power loss (3 of ~27 library objects redone) — must be resumed** (`cmake --build build -j4` in `~/orbslam3/ORB_SLAM3`, preferably on the 8 GB Pi).
